title: Polynomial nondeterministic time is contained in NP
statement: For every $c \in \mathbb{N}$, every language decidable by a finite nondeterministic Turing machine in time at most a constant multiple of $n^c+1$ belongs to $\mathrm{NP}$.
replaced: For every natural number $c$, the nondeterministic time class $\mathrm{NTIME}(n^c + 1)$ is contained in $\mathrm{NP}$: every language decided by some nondeterministic Turing machine within time $a\,(n^c+1)$, for a constant $a$, admits a polynomial-time verifier with certificates of exact length $2a\,(n+1)^c$.
